ABOUT MIC

About us

Meet the team ↗

The Multimedia and Intelligent Computing Lab (MIC) at Tongji University studies multimedia information computing and intelligent systems.

We explore efficient representations of visual data, intelligent optimization and the connections between computing and other fields.
